mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% signals strengthening economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 2% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4.5% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200,000, the labor market's dual signal predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in > 60% of triggered 5-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: An INDPRO reading above 120 signals peak supply chain efficiency, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as margins compress.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 55% of instances with INDPRO > 120.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth exceeding 5% month-over-month indicates surging consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between RSAFS growth and SPX returns falls below 0.1 over a 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in FEDFUNDS signal monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 50% of 60-day periods following two consecutive FEDFUNDS hikes.

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS growth slows to below 100,000 and UNRATE rises above 5%, the labor market's dual signal predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 55% of triggered 20-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST reading below 1800 signals sluggish housing demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth slows.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.
